title: EU battery rules: recycling efficiency targets for lithium batteries
snippet: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542: recycling efficiency for lithium-based batteries of 65% by average weight by end of 2025, 70% by 2030. Full details in the note file eu_battery_regulation.md.

title: European recycling capacity outlook 2026
snippet: Scenario figures: about 500,000 tonnes of collected lithium-based batteries in 2026; typical plant size 25,000 t/a. Details in recycling_capacity.md.
